h: Atiku reportedly accuses security agents of protecting Tinubu's banners in Kaduna
p: Atiku Abubakar has reportedly confronted the Tinubu camp over allegations that security agents guarded campaign banners in Kaduna ahead of the APC flag-off. The APC has in turn accused the ADC of a fake news plot around the rally. Neither side has produced evidence publicly.
more: The rally is the formal start of Tinubu's 2027 re-election campaign.
Both camps are trading accusations online.
Police have not commented on the banner claim.
